repos.description: An AI skill that provides design intelligence for building professional UI/UX across multiple platforms.
repos.summary_zh: UI UX Pro Max Skill 是一款AI驱动的设计智能工具，通过100条推理规则和67种UI样式库，实现专业级设计系统的自动生成。支持多平台框架，提供Python CLI命令行接口，可快速分析项目需求并输出定制化UI/UX方案，涵盖从布局模式到视觉风格的完整设计体系，显著提升设计效率与一致性。
repos.summary_en: UI UX Pro Max Skill is an AI-powered design intelligence tool that automatically generates professional design systems using 100 reasoning rules and 67 UI style libraries. Featuring a Python-based CLI, it analyzes project requirements and outputs customized UI/UX solutions—from hero-centric conversion patterns to soft UI evolution styles—enabling rapid creation of cohesive, production-ready design systems across web and mobile platforms while dramatically improving design efficiency, ensuring brand consistency, and reducing development iteration cycles.

repos.description: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet. Read & search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu — one CLI, zero API fees.
repos.summary_zh: Agent-Reach 为 AI 智能体提供命令行式全网接入，支持 Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、B站、小红书等平台，自动处理认证与反爬，零 API 费用实现跨平台内容读取与搜索。
repos.summary_en: Agent-Reach is a CLI tool that equips AI agents with cross-platform internet access across Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, Bilibili, and XiaoHongShu. It automatically handles authentication, anti-bot measures, and data cleaning—zero API fees, one command to install.

repos.description: Warp is an agentic development environment, born out of the terminal.
repos.summary_zh: Warp 是一款诞生于终端的智能体开发环境，深度集成 AI 编码助手并支持 Claude Code 等第三方 CLI 智能体。其 Oz 系统可自动化处理开源项目的 issue 管理、PR 审查等协作流程，提供实时智能体会话追踪与贡献者仪表板。采用 AGPL 开源协议，重塑开发者与 AI 协同编程体验。
repos.summary_en: Warp is an agentic development environment born from the terminal, deeply integrating AI coding assistants and supporting third-party CLI agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI. Its proprietary Oz system automates open-source project workflows including issue triage, PR reviews, spec writing, and community management. The platform provides real-time agent session tracking via build.warp.dev and comprehensive contributor dashboards. With OpenAI as founding sponsor and GPT-powered agentic workflows, Warp redefines developer-AI collaboration under AGPL open-source licensing while offering an MIT-licensed UI framework.

repos.description: Turn any website into a lightweight desktop app with one command, on macOS, Windows and Linux.
repos.summary_zh: Pake 是一款基于 Rust Tauri 的轻量级桌面应用打包工具，可将任意网页转化为独立原生应用。相比 Electron 应用体积缩小约 20 倍，仅 5MB 左右，内存占用更低且运行更快。支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 三大平台，提供 CLI 命令行一键打包和在线构建服务。内置快捷键、沉浸式窗口、样式定制、广告过滤等功能，已预打包微信读书、Twitter、Grok、DeepSeek 等常用应用。
repos.summary_en: Pake is a lightweight desktop app packaging tool built with Rust Tauri that converts any webpage into a native standalone application. It reduces package size by approximately 20x compared to Electron (around 5MB), with faster performance and lower memory usage. Supporting macOS, Windows, and Linux, it offers one-command packaging via CLI and online building. Features include keyboard shortcuts, immersive windows, style customization, and ad removal. Pre-built packages are available for popular services like WeRead, Twitter, Grok, and DeepSeek.

repos.description: "CLI-Anything: Making ALL Software Agent-Native" -- CLI-Hub: https://clianything.cc/
repos.summary_zh: CLI-Anything 通过自动化生成命令行接口，让任意软件 instantly 具备 AI 智能体原生调用能力。项目基于 Click 框架解析源码与 GUI，自动生成支持 JSON 结构化输出、撤销/重做和 REPL 的 CLI，无缝集成 Claude Code、Cursor 等主流 AI 编程助手，解决了 AI 控制存量软件的最后一公里问题，实现确定性、可组合的智能体工作流。
repos.summary_en: CLI-Anything revolutionizes software interaction by auto-generating command-line interfaces that make any application instantly accessible to AI agents. Built on Python's Click framework, it analyzes source code and GUI structures to create composable CLIs with structured JSON output, undo/redo capabilities, and REPL modes. Seamlessly integrating with Claude Code, Cursor, and other AI coding assistants, it bridges the critical gap between AI agents and legacy software, enabling deterministic, reliable agent-native workflows across diverse tools.

repos.description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents
repos.summary_zh: Vercel Labs推出的AI代理浏览器自动化CLI工具，基于Rust构建提供毫秒级响应。核心亮点是通过无障碍树引用(@e1)实现AI友好的元素定位，支持点击、填充、截图等操作，为AI代理提供高效网页交互能力。
repos.summary_en: Rust CLI for AI browser automation with sub-millisecond speed. Features accessibility tree references (@e1) for AI-friendly element interaction, including clicks, form fills, and screenshots.

repos.description: 3,000+ reusable AI agent skills for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Gemini CLI. AAS Core adds local catalog discovery, agent-owned selection and plan preview. CLI, MCP and plugins.
repos.summary_zh: Agentic Awesome Skills 是一个可安装的 GitHub 库，汇集 1936+ 个 agentic skills，专为 Claude Code、Cursor、Gemini CLI 等 AI 编码助手设计。提供 SKILL.md 结构化剧本、插件、捆绑包和工作流，支持编码、调试、测试、安全审查等任务。通过 npm 安装器实现多工具兼容，强化提示工程应用，提升 AI 代理上下文与输出质量，是社区驱动的 AI 开发自动化核心资源。
repos.summary_en: Agentic Awesome Skills is an installable GitHub library with 1,936+ reusable agentic skills for AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Cursor, and Gemini CLI. It delivers structured SKILL.md playbooks, plugins, bundles, and workflows for coding, debugging, testing, and security tasks. Featuring an npm installer and multi-tool compatibility, it strengthens prompt engineering to improve AI agent context and outputs, serving as a community hub for AI-assisted development automation.

repos.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.
repos.summary_zh: Magpie 是跨平台本地网关，统一管理 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 等 AI 编码智能体的模型配置。支持多供应商切换与配额耗尽自动故障转移，提供菜单栏、TUI、Web UI 及 CLI 界面，实现任意智能体与任意模型的灵活组合。
repos.summary_en: Magpie is a cross-platform local gateway that centralizes model configuration for multiple AI coding agents including Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI. It supports multi-provider switching, automatic failover when quotas are exhausted, and provides menu bar, TUI, Web UI, and CLI interfaces. Developers can flexibly pair any agent with any model across macOS, Windows, Linux, Docker, and Termux environments. One unified app manages all agent configs, provider keys, and routing rules, ensuring seamless model switching without manual intervention or downtime.

repos.description: Make Any Website into CLI & Use your logged-in browser by AI agent.
repos.summary_zh: OpenCLI 是一款将任意网站转换为命令行接口的自动化工具，核心在于让 AI 智能体通过已登录的浏览器操作网页（导航、填表、点击、数据提取）。内置 Bilibili、知乎等适配器，通过浏览器扩展与本地守护进程实现安全交互，支持自定义命令扩展，并集成本地工具与 Electron 应用，实现高效自动化与 AI 驱动交互。
repos.summary_en: OpenCLI is an automation tool that converts any website into a command-line interface (CLI), enabling AI agents to operate websites via a logged-in browser for navigation, form filling, clicking, and data extraction. It provides built-in adapters for platforms like Bilibili and Zhihu, a browser extension with a local daemon, and allows custom command extensions. It also integrates local tools and Electron apps, serving as a versatile hub for human and AI-driven automation workflows.

repos.description: Open-source 3D architecture software for AECO, scan-to-BIM. Agent-friendly, browser-first, MCP, CLI.
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Web 的 3D 建筑编辑器，提供浏览器内专业级 BIM 编辑能力。采用 React Three Fiber + WebGPU 实现高性能渲染，Turborepo  monorepo 架构分离核心逻辑与渲染层，Zustand 分层状态管理配合 IndexedDB 持久化与 Zundo 撤销重做，支持建筑模型的节点化数据管理与实时空间查询。
repos.summary_en: A web-based 3D building editor delivering professional BIM capabilities in-browser. Built on React Three Fiber + WebGPU for high-performance rendering, Turborepo monorepo architecture separates core logic from rendering, with layered Zustand state management, IndexedDB persistence, and Zundo undo/redo. Enables node-based building data management and real-time spatial queries.

repos.description: A maintained, feature-rich and performance oriented, neofetch like system information tool.
repos.summary_zh: Fastfetch 是一款用 C 语言编写的高性能系统信息展示工具，作为 neofetch 的现代替代品，专注于性能与可定制性。它支持 Linux、macOS、Windows、Android 等十余种操作系统，提供美观的视觉输出与丰富的配置选项。适用于开发者、系统管理员在终端快速获取并展示系统详情，支持多种包管理器一键安装，社区活跃且持续维护更新。
repos.summary_en: Fastfetch is a high-performance system information tool written in C, designed as a modern, maintained alternative to neofetch with emphasis on performance and customizability. It supports over 10 operating systems including Linux, macOS, Windows, Android, and various BSD variants, delivering visually appealing output with extensive configuration options. Ideal for developers and sysadmins to display system details in terminals, it offers easy installation via major package managers and maintains active community development with regular updates.

repos.description: Why is this running? Trace any process, port, container, or file back to what started it - CLI + TUI.
repos.summary_zh: witr是一款跨平台系统诊断工具，专为回答“为什么在运行”而生。它通过CLI或交互式TUI，一键追溯任意进程、端口、容器或文件的完整启动因果链，覆盖systemd、Docker、PM2等监督层，输出人类可读报告或JSON，补全传统ps/lsof工具的因果盲区，助力运维与排障。
repos.summary_en: witr is a cross-platform diagnostic CLI+TUI tool that answers “Why is this running?”. It traces any process, port, container or file back to its full startup causality chain—including supervisors like systemd, Docker and PM2—delivering human-readable output or machine-readable JSON in one command, filling the gap left by traditional tools like ps and lsof.

repos.description: Remove visible and invisible AI watermarks from images and video, and AI provenance metadata from images, video, and audio. Python library, CLI, and agent skill for SynthID, C2PA, EXIF, IPTC, XMP, and common generative-AI marks. By Victor Kuznetsov.
repos.summary_zh: 这个仓库提供CLI和库，用于移除AI生成图像的可见和不可见水印。支持Gemini、DALL-E、Stable Diffusion等主流模型，采用反向alpha混合算法快速移除Gemini的sparkle logo，通过扩散模型再生消除SynthID等不可见水印，并剥离C2PA、EXIF等元数据。具备智能人脸保护和批量处理能力，可绕过社交媒体AI检测。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers a comprehensive CLI and library solution for removing both visible and invisible AI watermarks from images generated by major models such as Google Gemini, OpenAI DALL-E, Stable Diffusion, Adobe Firefly, and Midjourney. It employs a novel reverse alpha blending algorithm to deterministically remove the Gemini/Nano Banana sparkle logo in under 0.05 seconds without GPU requirements, using a three-stage NCC detector for dynamic positioning. For invisible watermarks including SynthID, StableSignature, and TreeRing, it utilizes diffusion-based regeneration at native SDXL resolution (~1024px) with controlled noise addition and denoising. The tool comprehensively strips AI metadata (C2PA manifests, EXIF, XMP, PNG text chunks), removes "Made with AI" labels that trigger social media flags, and features Smart Face Protection to prevent AI distortion. Additional capabilities include Analog Humanizer adding film grain to bypass AI classifiers and efficient batch processing for directories.

repos.description: Extract any website’s design system into tokens in seconds: logo, colors, typography, borders & more. One command.
repos.summary_zh: Dembrandt 是一款一键提取任意网站设计系统的 CLI 工具。基于 Playwright 渲染页面并分析 DOM 计算样式，自动输出 Logo、颜色、字体、间距、边框、阴影、动效与组件等完整设计令牌，支持 W3C DTCG、shadcn/ui、Tailwind 等多格式导出，并可在 CI 中检测设计漂移，生成品牌指南或供 AI 代理使用。
repos.summary_en: Dembrandt is a CLI tool that extracts any website’s design system into standardized tokens in one command. Powered by Playwright, it analyzes computed DOM styles to capture logo, colors, typography, spacing, borders, shadows, motion and components. Outputs W3C DTCG, shadcn/ui, Tailwind themes and more; supports CI drift detection, brand guides and AI-agent ready DESIGN.md.

repos.description: Open source AI terminal for cloud and infrastructure management, enabling you to deploy, troubleshoot, and automate services using natural language and intelligent agents.
repos.summary_zh: Chaterm是一款AI原生的智能终端代理，旨在成为DevOps副驾驶。它通过自然语言交互重塑传统命令行体验，内置专家知识库和自主Agent引擎，可自动分解复杂任务并执行从日志分析到服务回滚的全链路操作。支持EC2、数据库和Kubernetes管理，提供智能上下文补全和移动端语音交互能力，消除技术栈认知壁垒，让开发者具备资深SRE的运维能力。
repos.summary_en: Chaterm is an AI-native intelligent terminal agent designed as a DevOps co-pilot. It revolutionizes the command-line experience through natural language interaction, featuring a built-in expert knowledge base and autonomous agent engine capable of planning and executing complex workflows from log analysis to service rollback. It manages EC2 instances, databases, and Kubernetes clusters while offering intelligent contextual completion and real-time voice interaction on mobile devices, empowering developers with SRE-level operational capabilities.

repos.description: A CLI for Twitter/X — feed, bookmarks, and user timeline in terminal
repos.summary_zh: 无需API密钥的Twitter/X终端客户端，支持浏览时间线、书签、搜索及发帖等完整功能。采用浏览器Cookie认证与TLS指纹模拟技术绕过检测，提供结构化JSON/YAML输出，专为AI智能体与自动化脚本设计，支持代理与速率限制规避。
repos.summary_en: Twitter/X CLI bypassing API keys via browser cookies and TLS spoofing. Full read/write operations with structured JSON/YAML output optimized for AI agents and automation scripts.

repos.description: Find, benchmark and install in CLI 170+ FREE coding LLM models across 15+ providers in real time
repos.summary_zh: 该工具解决了开发者在170+免费AI编程模型中选择的难题。它能实时并行测试15+提供商的模型，通过智能算法计算稳定性分数（综合p95延迟、抖动、峰值率和正常运行时间），并将最优模型一键集成到各种AI编程工具中，让开发者从选择到编码只需不到10秒。
repos.summary_en: This powerful CLI tool solves developers' biggest pain point when using free AI coding models: uncertainty about which model is fastest and most stable at any given moment. It continuously benchmarks approximately 170 free or free-limited coding LLMs across 15 trusted providers in real-time, calculating a comprehensive Stability Score that evaluates p95 latency (30%), jitter/variance (30%), spike rate (20%), and uptime (20%). Once you select a model, it instantly configures your preferred AI coding environment—whether it's Continue, Cline, OpenHands, Aider, or dozens of others—getting you from question to coding in under 10 seconds.

repos.description: distill any book down to its spine
repos.summary_zh: SpineDigest 是专为 AI 智能体设计的知识库 CLI 工具，支持将 EPUB、Markdown 和纯文本导入为可移植 .wikg 知识档案，利用大模型提取知识图谱、摘要与实体关系，并提供 URI 驱动的搜索、结构浏览和阅读模式。它将长文档转化为可维护、可导航的知识基地，而非一次性摘要输出，核心价值在于为 AI 代理提供源可追溯的结构化知识访问与上下文打包能力。
repos.summary_en: SpineDigest is a Node.js CLI optimized for AI agents that converts EPUB, Markdown, and text into portable .wikg knowledge archives. It leverages LLMs to extract knowledge graphs, summaries, and entities, exposing the archive via URI-based search, hierarchical structure, and reading modes. The primary artifact is the reusable .wikg file, enabling navigable, source-backed knowledge bases for long documents rather than one-shot summaries, with export options for AI context packing and reuse.

repos.summary_zh: soundshuman是反AI写作痕迹（slop）工具集，整合多款开源humanizer精华：Markdown技能像人类编辑重写文本（41种模式+统计特征+声线校准，禁止捏造），JSON规则包供机器强制执行，零依赖Node CLI实现全文评分、分析、修复与仓库扫描，并支持CI门禁与pre-commit钩子。目标是可检查工作流——可见规则、可解释分数、可审查diff，而非对抗检测器。适用于文档、博客、代码仓库内容质量把控与AI智能体写作。
repos.summary_en: soundshuman is an anti-AI-slop toolkit that merges the best of existing humanizers: a Markdown skill that rewrites prose like a careful human editor (41 patterns, statistical tells, voice calibration, no fabrication), a machine-enforceable JSON rule pack, and a zero-dependency Node CLI for scoring, analyzing, fixing, and scanning entire repos with CI gates and pre-commit hooks. It prioritizes an inspectable workflow—visible rules, explainable scores, reviewable diffs—over beating detectors. Ideal for docs, blogs, and keeping AI agents’ output natural.

repos.description: Paperclip — search, read, and analyze 8M+ biomedical papers from the command line
repos.summary_zh: Paperclip 是一款命令行工具，专为高效检索与分析 800 万+生物医学文献而设计。支持自然语言/正则搜索、并行 AI 阅读、SQL 查询及图表视觉分析，无缝集成 Unix 工具链。可作为 MCP 服务器赋能 AI 智能体，快速完成文献综述、监管文档查询等科研任务。
repos.summary_en: Paperclip is a command-line tool for rapid search and analysis of over 8 million biomedical papers. It enables natural language/regex search, parallel AI reading, SQL queries, and vision-based figure analysis, integrating seamlessly with Unix tools. As an MCP server, it empowers AI agents to efficiently conduct literature reviews and regulatory document queries.

repos.description: Find and track available single-word domains from your terminal.
repos.summary_zh: 终端CLI工具，用于快速查找可用单词域名。直接通过RDAP与WHOIS查询注册表，支持单词多TLD检查或扫描内置11822个品牌词列表，结果本地SQLite持久化并支持断点续扫。提供过滤排序、价格查询与交互式界面，严格区分available/registered/unknown状态，适合域名猎人与开发者高效发现优质域名。
repos.summary_en: Terminal CLI tool to find available single-word domains. Queries registries directly via RDAP and WHOIS, supports single-word multi-TLD checks or scanning 11,822 bundled brandable words. Results stored in local SQLite with resumable scans, filters, pricing and interactive TUI. Strictly separates available/registered/unknown states for reliable discovery by domain hunters and developers.
